title: French opinions fluency lesson
summary: Rebuilt the latest French week around the school task’s core language: the supplied Les opinions reference sheet, explicit teaching of les, retrieval of prior animal vocabulary, fast opinion-to-animal fluency, sentence construction, homework-ready writing and optional extension towards longer-term French fluency.

areas.title: Source sheets
areas.summary: Stored and made both supplied school sheets viewable inside InClass

areas.title: Reference sheet
areas.summary: Applied Je préfère, the five opinion symbols and the full school animal vocabulary

areas.title: Grammar teaching
areas.summary: Explicitly taught les for animals in general and plural forms such as oiseaux and chevaux

areas.title: Prior knowledge
areas.summary: Connected last week’s singular animal sentences to this week’s general opinions

areas.title: Fluency pathway
areas.summary: Added opinion recall, chunked sentence construction and rapid cue-to-French practice

areas.title: Homework readiness
areas.summary: Moved worksheet-style rehearsal after teaching so the paper homework should feel easy

areas.title: Extension
